# EVEngine

> C++20 Vulkan game engine. Games are EveScript (`.nut`, Squirrel-compatible). Agents must not invent Unity/Godot APIs.

## Entry rules (read first)

1. Open the matching `docs/usr/modules/<name>.md` and read **这篇解决什么** before the rest of the page. It names the problems, the preferred entry API, and what not to do.
2. Search by the problem (e.g. nearby units, in-range targets), then use the documented entry. Prefer `eve_api_search` / `eve_api_get` for exact signatures.
3. If the guide says do not scan a full unit array / rebuild a higher-level feature from primitives, do not use that as the main path.
4. When runtime cost looks wrong, profile at scale (`eve.Profiler.hotspots` / MCP `eve_profiler_hotspots`); a small scene is not evidence. Cost dims + hotspot rules: [docs/dev/API成本与Profiler约定.md](docs/dev/API成本与Profiler约定.md).

## For coding agents

- [.cursor/skills/README.md](.cursor/skills/README.md): skill index (language + mature game paradigms)
- [.cursor/skills/evescript/SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/evescript/SKILL.md): EveScript + conventions + concept map
- [.cursor/skills/eve-scene-search/SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/eve-scene-search/SKILL.md): semantic scene-object discovery, explicit spatial frames and MCP paging/recovery
- [docs/usr/modules/scene/semantic-search.md](docs/usr/modules/scene/semantic-search.md): local embedding setup, natural-text MCP connection and spatial-query walkthrough
- Paradigm skills (load by task): `eve-agent-loop`, `eve-game-loop`, `eve-arpg`, `eve-rpg`, `eve-rts`, `eve-action-guide`
- [docs/dev/AI知识补偿.md](docs/dev/AI知识补偿.md): why pretrained knowledge is missing and how to compensate
- [docs/usr/EVESCRIPT.md](docs/usr/EVESCRIPT.md): full language tutorial (humans)
- [docs/dev/API-CONVENTIONS.md](docs/dev/API-CONVENTIONS.md): `eve.X()`, errors, ownership
- Module guides with problem headers: e.g. [sensing](docs/usr/modules/sensing.md), [spatial](docs/usr/modules/spatial.md)
- Binding catalog: `python3 scripts/generate_binding_contracts.py --json-output eve-api.json`
- Asset kits (`eve.asset-kit.api`): MCP `eve_asset_kit_list` / `get` / `resolve`, CLI `python3 scripts/asset_kits.py`, or `cmake/sdk/asset-kits/` / SDK `share/eve/ai/asset-kits/` (`INTEGRATION.md` for internal systems)
- SDK zip (no git tree): `share/eve/ai/eve-api.json` + `share/eve/ai/SKILL.md` + `share/eve/ai/asset-kits/` + `.cursor/skills/*/SKILL.md` + root `llms.txt`

## For runtime agents

- [docs/dev/AI与MCP支持.md](docs/dev/AI与MCP支持.md)
- [docs/dev/Agent游戏开发范式.md](docs/dev/Agent游戏开发范式.md) (skill: `eve-agent-loop`)
- MCP: `eve_api_search` / `eve_api_get` (lookup), `eve_play` (observe/act), `eve_screenshot` (engine PNG), `eve_profiler_frame` / `eve_profiler_report` (hotspots)
- Do not use `eve_eval` as the official gameplay path
